summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py always returns an Update, with the empty-request path building the prologue from q.prologue[0]; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py. Nothing was run (per instructions), so tests and black formatting are unverified. The initial-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE clause honors initBindings and is the most likely to need adjustment. No commits were made.
